description: Current hiring snapshot for one role family: active-listing volume, seniority and remote mix, top skills and top hiring companies (point in time, not a time series). Omit `role` to list the role families. Without a key or with a free key you get the free layer (ranked tables trimmed); a key with paid market access gets every row. Same data as GET /api/v1/market/roles/{role}. Every result carries free_layer and paid_depth_url (free layer also dataset_depth_url).

role.description: Role family slug, e.g. engineering, data-ai, design. Omit to list all families.

name: get_hiring_trend
title: Get hiring snapshot by role
